title: British Airways Silver tier mapping
content: British Airways Club Silver corresponds to oneworld Sapphire status.

title: oneworld Sapphire lounge access
content: oneworld Sapphire members are generally eligible for Business Class or frequent flyer lounge access when departing on a flight that is both marketed and operated by a oneworld member airline. Lounge access remains subject to applicable exceptions and capacity restrictions.

title: oneworld Sapphire guest policy
content: oneworld Sapphire members may generally invite one guest into an eligible lounge. The guest must also be travelling on a flight marketed and operated by a oneworld member airline.

title: Qatar Airways alliance membership
content: Qatar Airways is a member of the oneworld alliance. It joined oneworld in 2013.

title: British Airways Silver core benefits
content: British Airways Club Silver benefits include priority check-in, priority boarding, free seat selection at booking in many cases, additional baggage allowance subject to fare restrictions, and lounge access when travelling with eligible British Airways or oneworld partner flights.
